learn_source: Watch the herbalist draw a batch of the festival tonic in the Town scene — the tonic that wards off the first frost takes hours by fire, minutes by cast
confirm_action: Cast it yourself on a vessel of water with something in it once
mana_effect: Quality only: at high mana the draw is deep and the brew comes out full-strength; at baseline it is weak and needs a second pass or a longer sit. Never whether the cast is possible.

receivers.physical_outcome: State-dependent: with herbs in it, the water takes their colour and virtue in moments; plain, no_effect — there is nothing to draw
no_effect — steeping needs water; the bundle just sits there
Faintly discolours from whatever leaf-litter is floating in it — an honest but unwanted brew
No physical effect — nothing is drawn out of a living body

receivers.reaction_kind: folds the caster into the work — hands over the actual kettle
